objectives:

1.瞭解鋼筋混凝土梁與柱之基本行為

2.分析與設計鋼筋混凝土梁與柱

3.認識ACI-318設計規範

1. Understand the fundamental behavior of RC beams and columns
2. Analyze and design of RC beams and short columns
3. Familiar with the design code ACI-318
